''See also: [[Death Monarch Yerin Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Yerin]] Arelius family{{!}}Arelius is a highly skilled [[sacred artist]] and the apprentice of both Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius and the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]]. Originally not a member of her clan by birth, she was adopted into the [[Arelius family]] as an outer member. A prodigious talent, she achieved [[Highgold]] status at a young age and eventually manifested the [[Death Icon]], an achievement that facilitated her ascension to the rank of [[Monarch]]. Known as the [[Death]] [[Monarch]], she possesses a specialized mastery over [[sword aura]] and her white-bladed weapon, [[Goldsign]]. Her combat style is characterized by extreme efficiency and the use of techniques like the [[Blood Shadow]]. Throughout her journey, she has faced formidable threats including [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]], driven by a purpose to kill such monsters rather than merely fight them. She is also recognized as the protector of the cult of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Yerin]] Arelius family{{!}}Arelius possesses red eyes and carries a pale [[sword]]. Around her waist, she wears a [[red rope]] of living [[madra]] that is rank with Blood aura{{!}}blood aura.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She protects the cult of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], despite having lost her home to The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix and harboring hatred for it. She also felt hatred toward her [[Blood Shadow]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As an [[Overlady]], she has cultivated her [[Blood Shadow]] using a [[technique]] developed by the [[Blood Sage]]. Her [[Goldsign]] manifests as a pair of silver arms that flatten into [[sword]]-blades.}}
